newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Traders detail Indian Oct kerosene tender results.
newsitem.headline: Traders detail Indian Oct kerosene tender results.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought three cargoes of kerosene from Kuwait Petroleum Corp (KPC) and two cargoes from U.S. major Mobil in its tender for October deliveries, the sellers confirmed on Monday.
KPC sold one 30,000-tonne cargo at a premium of 60-65 cents per barrel to MidEast spot quotes on a free-on board (fob) basis. The cargo will be for October 21-31 delivery to the Indian west coast.
KPC was awarded a 45,000-tonne cargo for October 11-31 delivery at $2.29 per barrel over MidEast quotes, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Madras or Haldia on the east coast.
Another 45,000-tonne cargo was awarded at the same price for October 21-31 delivery.

Mobil was awarded a 45,000-tonne cargo for October 11-20 at $2.18 per barrel above MidEast quotes, c-and-f East Coast, and another 45,000-tonne cargo at around $2.25-$2.28 premium for October 21-31 delivery, c-and-f east coast.
The IOC did not award a second tender it made seeking 45,000 tonnes of kerosene for Oct 1-5 deliveries to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast.
